commits.message:
fix(links): one fold joins a click's state writes, and review pass 1's smaller findings (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

A click's adjacent set-state and ring-state effects are joined once, at admission, into one state-writes step; set-state leaves the text batching beside reset-config. The step carries no verb of its own, and its write type no longer shares a name with the disclosure's. The menu trigger shares one render binding; the picker's close names the holding-current sentinel; the menu-action inverse sits beside its producer with a round-trip test; test helpers read a stepped ring through one lookup.

fix(links): a cycle link names its step, so clicks that land before the bar redraws add up (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

A set or persist cycle and a {{ menu }} trigger now carry the action and the
step, never the member they land on, so the link is the same on every draw and
N clicks land N steps. The click reads where the key stands when it arrives.

- a persist ring starts from what the bar wears while the session holds a pick
  of the key, and ring-config releases that pick so it stops shadowing the file
- a click's adjacent state writes (a trigger's step and its page reset) are one
  write: every pair validates before any lands
- a menu step reads in words by the member it opens, so two menus on one
  shared key never read alike

fix(stored-state): a per-session file that cannot be read shows ⚠ and survives the next save, and a restart at the bound keeps the sessions in use (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz) (#956)

* fix(state): a write over a state file that did not read sets it aside, and an unread answers book asks again (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

* fix(stored-state): a per-session file that cannot be read shows ⚠ and survives the next save, and a restart at the bound keeps the sessions in use (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

One holder now holds every per-session file: the session book, and a renderer profile's picks and history. It reads the file once, by the rule every state file keeps. A file that does not read is renamed aside beside itself before anything is written, and the store starts empty. A file that can be neither read nor renamed is never saved to, and stands on every bar as saving nothing.

A load's set-aside and what it dropped (a refused session, a retired pick or setting, an empty session) are a daemon event about the file, grouped by what and why.

Recency is the last request or write. A request moves its session in the renderer's stores, and the host hears that as a `heard` write; the wire version goes to 18. A move of place alone reaches the file within one order period and at a close, so the write rate does not grow with the tick.

* fix(stored-state): one set-aside of an unread file for every store, said where it went, and no false ⚠ after an edit (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

Law review pass 1 of #956.

- One executor sets an unread state file aside, for the answers book's
  transaction and a held store's load alike. It moves the file the bytes
  sit in, a link's target, so a symlinked answers book keeps its unread
  bytes and stays a link.
- One report type and one daemon translator: every store's load is
  logged (no file, N sessions and M dropped, set aside, refused), and a
  set-aside or a drop is a ⚠ event, the answers book's included.
- A renderer hands the host only what a load keeps, so edit mode's keys
  and a draft's steps never reach the file and a routine restart shows
  no ⚠.
- The holder keeps one fact for "the file lags the map", cleared only
  once a save returns. A put of what a session holds is a hearing, and
  every read before the load throws.
- One move-to-newest for every recency-ordered map. The settings
  history's hearing moves its one entry in place.

* fix(stored-state): one landing rule for every per-session file, replay what was taken before the load, and a landing carries its own reports (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

Law review pass 2. A per-session file writes where its link points, the
same rule its set-aside uses. A legacy name is retired unless it is the file
being set aside. A rollback that cannot put a set-aside back names the copy.
The config landing returns its store reports, and the daemon restates the
bar only when a report gave it something to show.

* fix(stored-state): the log names every dropped session, a closed file arms no order write, and a hearing moves only the history's order (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

Law review pass 3's minor items. The bar's event about a load's drops
expires, so the log line names every session. An order write is armed only
while the file is open. A hearing reorders the settings history through
replace, so no session's readers hear of it.
